# KAN-219: ThreadSanitizer suppressions for Native CI's TSan job.
# Qt's prebuilt libraries are not instrumented, and QMutex, QWaitCondition and
# QThreadPool hand work over with futexes and atomics that ThreadSanitizer
# cannot see. It then reports the memmove, pthread_cond_destroy and similar
# calls Qt makes itself. called_from_lib ignores only those intercepted calls
# from inside Qt; our own (instrumented) loads and stores are still checked.
called_from_lib:libQt6Core.so.6
called_from_lib:libQt6Test.so.6
# Qt Test's watchdog locks its std::mutex inside libQt6Test, which the line
# above hides, and then waits on it with std::condition_variable::wait in
# libstdc++, which ThreadSanitizer sees unlock a mutex it never saw locked.
# Only that mutex-misuse report inside condition_variable::wait is ignored;
# std::thread and condition variables in our own code stay checked.
mutex:std::condition_variable::wait
